complete_frame_definition: The fixed listed-URL acquisition plus lexical signal screening and AI source-context adjudication is complete. This flag does not assert complete TOI coverage, complete human review of every background body, known recall, or population event ascertainment.
observed_definition: Counts of confirmed positives identified by the completed pipeline are known; the number of real incidents outside this measurement process remains unknown.
limitations: Same search terms can have different recall across states and periods.
News attention and political salience may alter reporting and visibility.
Source-context coding is AI, not independent human verification.
All-zero detected pretreatment WB outcome leaves synthetic weights weakly or non-identified.
Detected-case contrast is an association in this measurement process, not a causal BJP effect.
